note: Hand-maintained prices for models LiteLLM has no entry for, and ids LiteLLM files under another name. USD per token, in LiteLLM's field names. A LiteLLM entry with the same id wins; remove an entry once LiteLLM carries it.

kimi-k3.source: LiteLLM's moonshot/kimi-k3 rates, which have no cache write; the write rate from OpenCode's list (https://opencode.ai/docs/zen), as Kimi's own table did not load

kimi-k3.1-pro.source: Kimi's API rates as quoted by https://seedrouter.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro-pricing and https://llmbenchmark.ai/pricing/moonshotai/kimi-k3-1-pro

kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed.source: https://github.com/muvon/octolib/blob/064220293e095f3f8ce6bc53981d26996b56468f/src/llm/providers/moonshot.rs (independent provider table and 5-minute/1-hour cache pricing; upstream verification dated 2026-09-22)

mimo-v2.5-pro.source: Xiaomi's overseas rates from 2026-05-27 (https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/news/latest/v2.5-price-update); cache writes are free; retired 2026-10-21

mimo-v2.5.source: Xiaomi's overseas rates from 2026-05-27 (https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/news/latest/v2.5-price-update); cache writes are free; retired 2026-10-21

glm-4.5.source: https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing; cached input storage is free for now, which LiteLLM's zai/ entries write as a zero cache write

minimax-m2.7.source: OpenCode's list (https://opencode.ai/docs/zen), as MiniMax no longer lists M2.7; the cache write rate of LiteLLM's minimax/ M2 entries

minimax-m2.7-highspeed.source: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c843cee062e08113f5afa101b0b6879824dd9025/model_prices_and_context_window.json, novita/minimax/minimax-m2.7-highspeed: input/output/cache-read rates. No independently verified cache-write rate.

grok-4.source: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/862736e74b4b697030994078b42c98856ed9911f/model_prices_and_context_window.json, xai/grok-4 and xai/grok-4-0709: historical input/output rates. No independently verified cache-read rate.

grok-4-fast.source: https://x.ai/news/grok-4-fast: reasoning and non-reasoning input/output/cache-read prices, including the above-128k context tier. Cross-checked against LiteLLM commit 862736e74b4b697030994078b42c98856ed9911f, xai/grok-4-fast-reasoning and xai/grok-4-fast-non-reasoning.

codex-auto-review.source: Codex's hidden approval reviewer; OpenAI publishes no price for it (https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/20981), so it counts as included in the Codex plan

gemini-3-pro-preview.source: Google no longer lists Gemini 3 Pro Preview; LiteLLM keeps its Vertex rates

gpt-5.3-codex-spark.source: A ChatGPT Pro research preview with no API price (https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/gpt-5-3-codex-spark); priced at GPT-5.3 Codex's rates

grok-build.source: The only Grok Build model on xAI's price page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models)

kimi-for-coding.source: Kimi Code's subscription id; it serves K2.8 Preview, which has no API price, and served K2.7 Code before

k3-256k.source: Kimi Code's id for K3 with a 256K context

k3.1-pro.source: Kimi Code's id for K3.1 Pro

k3.1-pro-highspeed.source: Kimi Code's id for K3.1 Pro Highspeed

mimo-v2-pro.source: Xiaomi routed mimo-v2-pro to V2.5, at V2.5 prices, from 2026-06-01

mimo-v2-flash.source: Xiaomi routed mimo-v2-flash to V2.5, at V2.5 prices, from 2026-06-18

grok-4-1-fast-reasoning.source: LiteLLM commit 2590f641f5c8dca9127deed2a90dd44bc3cd05aa: preserved Grok 4.1 Fast Vertex rates under the corresponding provider-prefixed id

grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning.source: LiteLLM commit 2590f641f5c8dca9127deed2a90dd44bc3cd05aa: preserved Grok 4.1 Fast Vertex rates under the corresponding provider-prefixed id
